case_assessment.summary: The graph captures the core ignition-to-fire sequence, but it compresses an important documented escalation step and contains one evidence-format problem. The main logical improvement is to make Ev1 explicitly represent the initial oxidizer-bay fire and its spread to the flammable liquid storage area, which better matches the chosen Pool fire consequence.
main_problems: Ev1 is narrower than the downstream Pool fire consequence and does not explicitly include the documented spread to the flammable liquid storage area.
The Ev1 -> H1 edge is overly compressed under the current Ev1 wording.
H1 evidence is not strictly verbatim and does not follow the schema evidence rule.
